summary.overall: Feature code follows the existing local-boundary architecture: Sheets remains the business fact store, SQLite stores scheduler technical state, and Telegram sends go through NotificationRouter. The main maintainability issue is reminder rerun idempotency: successful reminder state is recorded but not consulted by SchedulerService.run_reminder.

findings.title: Reminder reruns can duplicate successful participant reminders
findings.description: SchedulerJobRepository exposes has_successful_reminder() and repository tests assert it can prevent duplicate sends, but SchedulerService.run_reminder() never checks that state before sending. A rerun of the same reminder type/week can send a second Telegram reminder to participants that already received the first send.
findings.impact: Violates the tech-spec requirement that reminder state prevents duplicate successful sends for the same reminder job. It can create noisy participant notifications after scheduler restarts or manual reruns.
findings.recommendation: Before _send_reminder_with_retry(), map reminder_type with _reminder_log_type() and skip participants for which repository.has_successful_reminder(participant_id, week_number=week_number, reminder_type=log_type) is true. Add a regression test that running the same reminder twice sends once and reports the second run as skipped.

findings.title: Admin error notification failures can abort scheduler recovery paths
findings.description: _notify_admin_error() records an error event and then sends through NotificationRouter. If the error bot raises, the scheduler path that was handling a participant, Sheets, or silent-notification failure will raise too.
findings.impact: A secondary admin-notification outage could stop a reminder or week-close loop even though the primary failure was intended to be isolated. Current fake tests do not cover error-bot failure.
findings.recommendation: Decide whether admin notification is best-effort for scheduler jobs. If yes, catch exceptions around the TECHNICAL_ERROR send after persisting error_events, and add a regression test with a failing error_bot.

positive_notes: Scheduler business facts are written to Sheets rows, while retry/job/error state is kept in SQLite.
Participant reminders, operational notifications, and admin errors use the existing three-bot NotificationRouter boundary.
Week-close gray row creation is idempotent at the Sheets read/write boundary and has partial-failure tests.
Silent notifications are grouped by team and covered for cross-team leakage and draft-state privacy.

verification.automated: Report JSON validity checked with python json.tool
